Title: Beachcomber Bowl
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind deep round bowl in clear sea-green, with the whole floor of it beachcombed: tiny shells, little starfish, crushed glass like wet sand, and a single piece of soft green sea glass sitting off to one side. A band of small striped and speckled shells runs right round the inside wall, and drifts of green thread through the sand like seaweed caught on the tide.

The walls are clear enough to see straight through to the shells packed underneath, so it catches the light from every side. Roughly 20 cm across and deep enough to be a centrepiece rather than a catch-all.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Everlasting Bowl
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind bowl with real dried strawflowers set right through the clear resin walls — rust and amber and burnt gold, each one caught open with its papery petals spread. Strawflowers are known as everlastings because they hold their colour for years after drying, and set in resin they will hold it indefinitely.

Every flower in it was grown, dried and set by Janet herself. Because dried flowers float, a piece like this cannot be poured in one go — it is built up over three separate pours of deep-pour resin, each left days to cure before the next layer of flowers goes in.

The oval well measures about 6.5 × 9 cm: it takes a flameless pillar candle or a votive in its own glass, and does just as nicely holding rings overnight. Please use flameless candles, or a candle in glass — resin softens with direct heat.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Everlasting Stone

Title: Frozen Lagoon
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind round tray ringed with a raised cluster of turquoise crystals, rough-cut and glassy, with fine glitter caught deep inside them. The centre is a smooth flat pool of the same turquoise, so a pillar candle sits level in the middle of it and the light picks up every facet around the rim.

About 15 cm across. Equally good holding rings and earrings by a bedside. Please use flameless candles, or a candle in its own glass — resin softens with direct heat.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Flower Power Hands — Pair
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind pair of clenched hands — one left, one right — packed through with real dried flowers in deep red, burgundy and bright yellow. They face each other, which is the whole point of them, and the well in the top of each one holds pens, brushes, a small posy or whatever lands on the desk.

Because dried flowers float, a piece like this cannot be poured in one go — each hand is built up over three separate pours of deep-pour resin, with days of curing between them. Six pours across the pair, and the better part of a week.

Sold as a pair.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Everlasting Hands
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind pair of cupped open palms holding a gathering of dried flowers — burnt orange strawflowers, deep purple and soft cream, caught mid-offering. The fingers and thumbs come out almost clear, so the flowers sit inside the hands like something just picked and carried in.

Some of the flowers were grown and dried in Janet's own garden. Because dried flowers float, the piece is built up over three separate pours of deep-pour resin, each left days to cure before the next layer goes in.

Title: Ember Bloom Bowl
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind freeform bowl in four colours — deep crimson pooling at the centre, rising through amber and burnt orange to a clear yellow at the torn petal edge. The rim is jagged and irregular, shaped by hand while the resin was still soft, so no two points around it are alike.

About 17 cm across. Lit from behind or set near a window it goes from deep red to glowing amber as you move around it.

Title: Limelight
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind round tray ringed with a raised cluster of clear crystals, rough-cut and glassy, with a lime-green bloom opening right across the centre and a scatter of glitter at its heart.

The bloom is a three-dimensional technique that takes a second pour to achieve — the flower has to open into the resin at just the right moment, and it cannot be redone if it goes wrong. About 15 cm across.

Takes a flameless pillar candle or a votive in its own glass — resin softens with direct heat. Just as good holding rings and earrings.

Handmade, one-of-a-kind resin art by We're Cured!

Title: Opal Halo
Body (HTML):
A one-of-a-kind domed candle holder, milky and opalescent, filled with iridescent cellophane that flashes pink, green and gold as the light moves across it. Solid and surprisingly heavy in the hand for its size — it sits like a river stone.

Every one of those strips was cut by hand. The shredder would not take them, so it was done with scissors.

The well measures about 6 cm across. Takes a flameless tealight or pillar, or a candle in its own glass — resin softens with direct heat.
